title: Beats Mercedes and rivals
summary: The fragments mostly contain broad comparative statements about the G70 outperforming Mercedes or other competitors, with only one clearly positive example and many quotes lacking enough context for firm sentiment classification.

positive.summary: Positive feedback describes the vehicle as outstanding and better than alternatives in overall quality.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined fragments make favorable-sounding comparison claims against Mercedes or competitors, but the excerpts are too isolated or ambiguously framed to confirm sentiment reliably.

limitations: Most sampled fragments are very short comparative quotes with limited context, so sentiment is often undetermined.
One fragment references BMW and the 7 Series rather than clearly the G70, so the topic may mix in cross-vehicle comparison language.
The sample is small and stratified, so it should not be treated as representative of all G70 reviews on this topic.
